name: labs/uwo-fast__openreactor
title: openreactor RLHT heater slice (openreactor.rlht.RlhtSlice)
intro: openreactor RLHT heater slice (openreactor.rlht.RlhtSlice), adapted from uwo-fast/openreactor. It reads `state`, `version`, `mode`, `estop` and 2 more; sets `setpoint_1` and `setpoint_2`; runs `stop_heating`. `stop_heating`: put both heater outputs in the safe state (setpoints zero, then open-loop duty zero). A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
